history.detail: T3: Add/adjust tests and make them pass

AC10: "(new)" -> "An assignment at any layer that names a provider the operator has not connected (or a model that provider does not offer) is treated as unresolved at that layer and falls through to the next one, at every call site - `review tier`, `spawn_subagent`, `keryx routing list` and `/routing` - and the CLI and the modal show "<provider>/<model> - not connected, falling back to <resolved>"; tests cover each call site." (review of PR #705 (finding 1): the operator's fallback requirement from PRD section 5 was documented but not implemented and had not been carried into an AC)

AC11: "(new)" -> "A project `routing.config.json` takes effect only after the operator approves its current content once (a content hash recorded per user, like other project trust in keryx); until then, and whenever the file changes, its entries are ignored with a visible notice in `keryx routing list`, `/routing` and the review tier output, and `keryx routing trust` (or a confirmation in `/routing`) approves it; a routed review model is labelled as routed, never as discovered." (review of PR #705 (finding 2): a checked-in routing file could silently redirect the model that reviews the same diff)
